## Load packages and data

```{r load-packages, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse) 
library(datasauRus)
```

## Exercises

### Exercise 1

Based on the `datasaurus_dozen` help, there are 1846 rows and 3 coulumns in the dataset. The 3 variables are:

- dataset
- x
- y

```{r frequency table}
datasaurus_dozen %>%
  count(dataset)  # %>%
#  print(13)
```

### Exercise 2

#### Scatterplot of the dino dataset

```{r plot-dino, fig.height=3, fig.width=6}
dino_data <- datasaurus_dozen %>%
  filter(dataset == "dino")

ggplot(data = dino_data, mapping = aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_point()
```

#### Correlation between `x` and `y` in the dino dataset

```{r cor-dino}
dino_data %>%
  summarize(r = cor(x, y))
```

### Exercise 5

#### Scatterplot of all the datasets

```{r plot-all, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 9}
ggplot(datasaurus_dozen, aes(x = x, y = y, color = dataset))+
  geom_point()+
  facet_wrap(~ dataset, ncol = 3) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

#### Correlation between `x` and `y` in each dataset

```{r cor-all}
datasaurus_dozen %>%
  group_by(dataset) %>%
  summarize(r = cor(x, y)) #%>%
  #print(13)
```
